# reMarkable

> reMarkable creates paper-like digital tablets designed to enhance focus, creativity, and productivity through natural handwriting and note-taking experiences.

reMarkable offers a range of digital paper tablets (Paper Pro, Paper Pro Move, and reMarkable 2) that combine paper-like writing experiences with digital organization features. The platform serves both individual creative professionals and enterprise teams seeking distraction-free work environments.
